home.hero_sub: Design, build and ship. From a landing page to an admin panel that runs it.
home.step1_body: I look at what you have and where the site loses people. You get a list of fixes and a price.
home.step2_body: Layout, front end, integrations. You see a working version at every step, not only at the end.
home.step3_body: Domain, certificate, analytics, backups. Then changes whenever you need them.
home.cta_body: I reply within a day. If it is not my kind of work, I say so and point you somewhere better.
home.craft_lead: Three steps and one person across all of them. No handoffs between a designer, a markup guy and an admin, where half the idea usually gets lost.
home.cta_brief_body: What the project is, the deadline, and what already exists: copy, a mockup, an old site. Three sentences is enough, the rest we sort out over email.
home.cta_terms_body: A landing page takes two or three weeks, a site with an admin panel one and a half to two months. I quote after reading the task and before starting, and the number does not grow along the way.
home.cta_next_body: I read your message, ask what is unclear and send back a list of fixes with timings. It commits you to nothing: if we do not fit, you keep the review of your site.

about.title: Vlad
about.lead: Web developer. I build sites end to end: from the layout to the server it runs on.
about.body1: I started by cutting other people's mockups, now I usually take the whole project. Fewer seams that way: the person drawing the screen and the person deploying it is the same person.
about.body2: I work with small businesses and teams under ten people. I like problems where the result shows up in numbers, not only in compliments.
about.now_body: Building a control panel for my own hosting: container deploys for guest sites, domains, logs and load metrics.
